data.title: 菲亚梅塔 · 标好的路线
data.description: 她把目的地圈出来，又补上一条绕开施工路段的路线。地图折好后，她确认你也记住了集合时间。
data.camera: 俯角中景，地图和手部清晰
data.promptProse: At a spacious, light-filled planning table, Fiammetta leans forward, pencil in hand, to meticulously mark a strategic path across a large-scale paper map. Scattered reference charts, topographic diagrams, and a ruler lie beside her, with soft, natural window light illuminating the crisp paper textures and her sharp, professional focus on the tactical details.
data.animaCaption: Leaning forward over a wide planning table, she holds a pencil steady to trace a tactical route across a large paper map. Crisp window daylight highlights the scattered charts, ruler, and her sharp, focused gaze.
